old_problem: Proprietary selector/mode semantics, injector-consumer topology, expected ACA/deferred/EEPROM mutations, reset identity and phase recovery are unapproved.
disposition_reason: This case intentionally crashes the injector, mutates persistent EEPROM state and resets a GPU. test_case.test_name: AMD SDMA poison consumption ODECC and CRC-write recovery validation
test_case.purpose: Prove SDMA consumes poison for both approved producers, terminates the injector as designed, records authoritative RAS/persistent evidence and returns the correct GPU to healthy service.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras version/hash/license and matching driver
AMD block1/selector130/type8 default-ODECC and mode5 CRC-write authority
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records all-GPU, counter, EEPROM and log baseline; validates target and semantics; runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 1 -s 130 -t 8` once; captures SIGBUS/core metadata, poison-created/consumed, ACA/address/deferred/EEPROM and reset timeline; completes approved recovery and clean rebaseline; only then separately authorizes and runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 1 -s 130 -t 8 -m 5` once and repeats variant-specific evidence and final recovery.
test_case.expected_result: Each phase independently produces the approved producer-specific poison evidence, expected SIGBUS, client8 consumption, authoritative ACA/deferred and16-page persistence relationship, resets/resumes the mapped GPU and leaves no unresolved errors or unhealthy peer.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both phases independently meet their exact oracle and recovered-state gate. Generic dmesg, copied sample addresses, wrong BDF reset, unapproved EEPROM mutation, missing core evidence or incomplete recovery fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle recoverable GPU SUT with explicit poison/reset approval and OOB access.
Approve persistent EEPROM effect and cleanup before phase one.
Stop before CRC-write unless ODECC recovery and rebaseline are complete.
One attempt per phase; no automatic retry or reset.
expected_evidence: Pre/post UMC, EEPROM and complete log baselines
Approved cleanup/rebaseline then separate mode5 CRC-write evidence
Final EEPROM reconciliation and all-GPU/driver/host health
test_case.recovery: On wrong GPU, failed reset, persistent error growth, EEPROM mismatch or lost connectivity, stop and preserve evidence; use only approved OOB/GPU/reboot recovery and persistent-state cleanup, then verify every GPU before any new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and criteria consistently separate ODECC and CRC-write poison paths; literal addresses/counts are topology-dependent examples, not contradictory intent.
